news.title: 因應歐盟 CRA 新規 研華攜手 DEKRA 德凱簽署 MOU
news.summary: 隨著歐盟《網路韌性法案》（Cyber Resilience Act, CRA）逐步進入實施階段，資安合規正成為工業設備與邊緣 AI 產品進入全球市場的重要門檻。研華（2395）宣布攜手全球領先的檢驗、檢測與驗證機構DEKRA德凱，結合雙方在工業運算、資安測試與全球認證的專業，協助終端應用客戶與系統整合商從產品設計階段即導入資安要求，加速因應歐盟CRA法規要求與IEC 62443標準等規範，降低合規風險並縮短產品進入全球市場的時程。
news.title_en: In response to EU CRA new regulations, Advantech partners with DEKRA to sign MOU
news.summary_en: As the EU's Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) gradually enters implementation phase, cybersecurity compliance is becoming a critical threshold for industrial equipment and edge AI products entering global markets. Advantech （2395） announced partnership with global leading testing, inspection and certification body DEKRA, combining both parties' expertise in industrial computing, security testing and global certification, to help end-application customers and system integrators introduce security requirements from product design stage, accelerate compliance with EU CRA regulations and IEC 62443 standards, reducing compliance risks and shortening time-to-market for products globally.

news.title: 緯創醫學攜長庚科技大學 共育 AI 智慧照護人才 推動智慧健康創新應用
news.summary: 面對超高齡社會帶來的照護需求，以及人工智慧與數位科技在健康照護領域的快速發展，如何將科技創新轉化為實際照護應用，已成為產業發展的重要課題。緯創（3231）旗下緯創醫學科技股份有限公司20日與長庚科技大學於長庚科大林口校區簽署合作備忘錄（MOU），共同推動「AI賦能高齡暨健康產業人才培訓精進計畫」，整合產業實務與學術資源，深化智慧健康、高齡照護及數位健康領域合作。雙方將透過人才培育、研究合作及場域實踐，培養具備AI應用能力之健康照護人才，並共同推動創新科技於健康照護領域之應用與發展。

news.summary: 統一（1216）UNIDESIGN系列商品持續擴大萬家福、樂家康自有品牌布局，從食品、清潔用品到居家日用品，透過兼顧品質與價格的商品策略，帶動消費者購買熱度。自7月起，系列商品陸續恢復供應多款人氣品項，並持續擴充商品陣容，截至10月已推出80款商品。其中，非籠飼平飼新鮮蛋7至9月業績突破2,370萬元，居系列熱銷排行榜之冠；純水、冷凍水餃及衛生紙等民生商品也展現強勁銷售動能，反映消費者對高性價比日常用品的需求。

news.summary_en: Uni-President （1216） UNIDESIGN series products continue to expand Wanjiafu, Lejiakang own brand layout, from food, cleaning supplies to household daily necessities, through product strategy balancing quality and price, driving consumer purchasing heat. Since 7 month, series products successively restore supply of many popular items, and continue to expand product lineup, as of 10 month have launched 80 items. Among them, cage-free free-range fresh eggs 7 to 9 month performance exceeds 23700000 yuan, ranking top of series best-selling list; pure water, frozen dumplings and toilet paper etc. daily necessities also show strong sales momentum, reflecting consumer demand for high cost-performance daily necessities.

news.title_en: Taiwan Cement Shalu Water Distribution Center Small Hydropower Plant wins first 'Outstanding Diverse Green Energy Award'
news.summary_en: The first 'Outstanding Diverse Green Energy Award' ceremony was held on October 16 morning at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition 1 Hall. Taiwan Cement （1326） won the 'Outstanding Installation System Award - Diverse Energy' from the Ministry of Economic Affairs Energy Bureau for its 'Shalu Water Distribution Center Small Hydropower Plant', with Taiwan Cement Vice President Wang Chi-chou attending to accept the award. The company stated that this award demonstrates Taiwan Cement's technical strength in integrating hydropower, water supply safety, and intelligent operations and maintenance, and establishes a demonstration model for creating green energy value from existing water supply facilities.

items.title: Credo新品助陣＋彭双浪駁林恩平觀點 友達靠 Micro LED 衝 CPO 還有戲
items.summary: 大立光（3008）董事長林恩平日前一席Micro LED切入CPO「不可行」的談話，引發市場議論。友達（2409）董事長彭双浪出面高喊「應該是誤解」，強調技術各有優劣，加上輝達高速傳輸關鍵夥伴Credo端出微發光架構新品助陣，透露友達與富采（3714）、鼎元（2426）等泛友達集團成員以Micro LED攻CPO不僅還有戲，更已展開總動員出擊。

items.title: 友達30周年運動會 凝聚集團能量展 One AUO 新篇章
items.summary: 友達（2409）董事長彭双浪17日表示，面對AI浪潮帶來的產業變革契機，友達積極布局AI四支箭等前瞻創新事業，結合集團資源與生態圈夥伴力量，加速推動包含：CPO光通訊、玻璃核心基板相關半導體先進封裝技術、AR眼鏡及低軌衛星通訊天線等新技術、新應用與新商業模式落地，朝向更智慧、更永續、更具韌性的企業轉型目標全速邁進。

news.title_en: Google breaks through key bottleneck in quantum computing, expected to accelerate development
news.summary_en: Google's Quantum AI team achieves key breakthrough in quantum computing, reducing quantum error rate by approx 40x, expected to significantly cut hardware costs for building practical quantum systems, accelerating commercialization. Among Taiwanese hardware makers, Quanta （2382）, Foxconn （2317）, Inventec （2324）, Kinpo （2312） and other major firms have invested in related research; in post-quantum cryptography, Chunghwa Telecom （6163）, Phison （6590） and other vendors are participating.

ai_commentary_en.summary:
Taiwan market splits: semiconductors lead broad decline with TSMC, MediaTek, Delta flashing bearish momentum and heavy foreign outflow, while financials (Fubon, Cathay) and plastics (Nan Ya) sustain strong uptrends on earnings upgrades. Memory sector (Nanya Tech) collapses on cycle fears. Sector rotation favors defensives over AI hardware near-term.

Trade/retail leads gains; telecom/AI warm with foreign buying. Semiconductors and components cool amid heavy foreign selling. Financials mixed: CTBC strong, Taishin lagging. Broad market shows sector rotation with defensive and AI themes outperforming cyclical tech.

Market rotates from semiconductors (-1.57%) and plastics (-5.31%) toward trade/retail (+2.01%), steel, and financials. Foreign capital exits tech heavily (-482k shares) while accumulating steel (+148k) and financials (+141k). Mixed breadth with defensive sectors leading.

Market diverges with financials and domestic consumption resilient amid tech sector correction; foreign capital rotates from semiconductors into steel, retail, and select financials; high sector correlations suggest systemic risk if tech selling intensifies; watch foreign flow direction and 20-day MA breadth.

Market mixed: financials and telecoms show strong uptrends with institutional accumulation, while petrochemicals and biotech face selling pressure. Tech hardware diverges — Evergreen Marine and Uni-President hold gains, but Wistron and Walsin Lihwa deep in downtrends despite oversold bounces. Foreign capital rotates selectively.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation with financials and telecom leading while semiconductors and panels lag. Institutional accumulation supports 5880, 4904, 3034, 2801; heavy foreign selling pressures 3481, 2449, 6770. Overbought conditions prevalent in leaders; oversold bounce candidates in laggards. Key catalysts: earnings guidance, merger outcomes, Apple supply chain.

Market bifurcates: defensive sectors (retail, food, telecom, steel) attract foreign capital while semiconductors face heavy selling (-482K shares). Steel leads with 148K foreign buying amid energy crisis hedging. Tech rotation evident as AI beneficiaries gain but component names weaken. Selective strength in AI power supply and PCB chains contrasts broad semiconductor fatigue.

Trade/retail leads gains (+2%) on institutional buying while semiconductors retreat (-1.6%) amid foreign selling. Financials and shipping show resilient uptrends with strong foreign accumulation. Optoelectronics mixed as AUO surges on Micro LED/AI glass but sector breadth weak. Divergence widens between AI-driven hardware and cyclical laggards.

Market mixed as trade/retail leads (+2%) while semiconductors drag (-1.6%) with heavy foreign selling. Financials and steel attract foreign buying. Glass sector neutral but Taiwan Glass surges on fiberglass shortage. AI server supply chain names draw interest despite broad tech weakness.

Mixed signals: semiconductors cool with heavy foreign selling while trade/retail and food sectors show strength. AI names diverge—optical (6442) and power (6415) hold uptrends but face profit-taking; memory (6531) and wafer (3532) under pressure. Financials neutral.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation: trade/retail and food strong with foreign buying, but semiconductors and ETFs face heavy foreign selling. 0050 reflects this, with foreign outflow of 225k shares despite retail odd-lot support. Technicals weakening below 20-day MA, momentum bearish; broader sentiment hinges on semiconductor recovery.
